verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Superhuman data export feature, an export format, or an offboarding path. That Superhuman runs on top of Gmail/Outlook is a host-platform property, not the product's own export capability. The MCP server lets AI assistants read and draft emails, but that is a developer building block, not an export of all user data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
